title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila stops Chandayatha from speaking about Pallavan's mother. After mutual apologies smooth things over, Chozhan praises Nila but urges her to keep her self-respect.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: After Revathi blames him, Thangaraj takes his family on a movie outing. However, the outing turns sour as his phone calls annoy others, while Revathi struggles with the children.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Savithri and Thamarai tease Aishwarya for mimicking Tamizhselvi and reveal that Chithra tied her own nuptial chain. Later, Sethupathi suspects Aishwarya framed Tamizhselvi.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Jaganathan seeks a promise from Karthik about Kasthuri. Tensed by his dance rehearsal, Kasthuri asks Karthik to pair up with her, while Madhu is thrilled when Arjun visits.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani hopes Anbu stays for her competition, but Vennila wants him at a key meeting. Later, Kanmani is shocked when organisers reveal her company isn't listed for the finals.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy refuses to spend beyond his budget on the grand reception after comparing the expenses. Angered by his decision, Abhi's parents call off the reception plan.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi shouts at everyone for teasing her after the wedding night, before Sakthivel invites Pandian's family for lunch. Accepting, the family visits Muthuvel's house.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Ravi quits his job at Shruthi's restaurant and asks his family to ignore her until she repents. Later, Meena suspects Shruthi has not terminated her pregnancy and tells Muthu.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri apologizes to Sudar, taking the duo out walking and helping a hurt Abinaya. Meanwhile, Divya proposes to Prabhakaran, who eagerly promises to care for her always.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: The groom's family agrees to Senthamizh's wish to pursue her studies after Manjamalai reveals her decision. Later, Thennavan angrily scolds her for not joining him on an outing.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi and Nalini discover Kalamma's plan to send Ayyappan to Malaysia after failing to find him. Meanwhile, Sethji urges Kalamma to return the money borrowed for the election.
